channel.title: World
channel.description: The Washington Post World section provides information and analysis of breaking world news stories. In addition to our world news and video, Post World News offers discussions and blogs on major international news and economic issues.

item.title: USS Abraham Lincoln docks in Thailand after 9 months at sea
item.dc:creator: Andrew Nachemson, Aoife Walsh
item.description: The crew will get a chance to “rest and recharge” in the beach destination of Pattaya, after reports of deteriorating conditions aboard the aircraft carrier.

item.title: Iran retaliates with missiles and drones, defying Trump’s warning
item.dc:creator: Alex Horton, Rachel Chason
item.description: President Donald Trump had warned after Tuesday's U.S. strikes that any retaliation would see Iran “hit again at a much harder and higher level.”

item.title: Russia’s jet-powered drones are overwhelming Ukraine’s air defenses
item.dc:creator: Mary Ilyushina
item.description: Russia is pounding Ukraine with jet-propelled drones, forcing Kyiv to adapt once again in an arms race that is increasingly defining the war.

item.title: Syria, eyeing role as Middle East hub, offers options to bypass Hormuz
item.dc:creator: Gerry Shih
item.description: The wartime blockage of cargo traffic in the Strait of Hormuz is a boon for Syria, which is poised to capitalize on a need for alternative transit routes for oil.

item.title: Germany blames Russia for drone attack on airport, announces countermeasures
item.dc:creator: Catherine Belton
item.description: Officials said the Aug. 4 attempt was part of a campaign aimed at undermining European support for Ukraine against Russia.

item.title: Trump said his deal with Venezuela would lower gas prices. Will it?
item.dc:creator: Evan Halper, Anthony Faiola, Samantha Schmidt, Karen DeYoung
item.description: It is likely to be years before oil production meaningfully ramps up, industry experts say, and there are many risks involved.

item.title: Putin pledges support to Iran, rallies leaders to challenge U.S.
item.dc:creator: Mary Ilyushina
item.description: A regional security meeting in Kyrgyzstan highlighted the increasingly close military and political alliance between Moscow and Tehran.

item.title: This dog raced across the backs of 56 people to set a world record
item.dc:creator: Kyle Melnick
item.description: The Australian shepherd, Chardonnay, jumped around with excitement after her feat.

item.title: Former prime minister Keir Starmer says he’ll leave Parliament
item.dc:creator: Violet Jira
item.description: After resigning as prime minister in July, the decision signals an end to his domestic political career.

item.title: Canadian special elections indicate voters backing Carney’s stand against Trump
item.dc:creator: Aoife Walsh
item.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney had vowed to match U.S. tariffs "dollar for dollar," unlike other longtime U.S. partners who had raced to cut deals when faced with tariff threats.

item.title: China, which once took the world’s factory jobs, is now losing them
item.dc:creator: Joshua Yang
item.description: Income inequality in China is now by some measures worse than in the U.S. as blue-collar jobs dwindle and workers turn to the gig economy.

item.title: Lake Ontario is now Lake America. Residents of Trump-voting Ontario have thoughts.
item.dc:creator: Laura Beveridge
item.description: The president’s order to rename the Great Lake has sparked both pride and objections among residents of Upstate New York.

item.title: Russian finance minister, invited by Trump, draws objections at G-20 meeting
item.dc:creator: Riley Beggin, Catherine Belton
item.description: As Moscow pounds Ukraine, the appearance by Finance Minister Anton Siluanov was “quite troubling,” said one attendee. U.S. officials cited a need for “dialogue.”

item.title: Iran, accustomed to sanctions, cites pain of new U.S. pressure but doesn’t bend
item.dc:creator: Rachel Chason
item.description: President Donald Trump said that the United States, which had transitioned largely to economic warfare, would respond militarily to an Iranian attack on Jordan.

item.title: Soccer great Lionel Messi announces retirement from Argentina’s national team
item.dc:creator: Amy B Wang, Mariana Alfaro
item.description: “There isn’t much time left, and different chapters are coming to an end. This is one that hurts me a lot,” the 2022 World Cup winner wrote on Instagram.

item.title: Iceland opposes E.U. membership talks as local concerns outweigh fears of Trump
item.dc:creator: Aoife Walsh
item.description: Opponents of restarting negotiations to join the European Union argued that joining the bloc would undermine national control of fishing, farming and other top priorities.

item.title: A U.S. strike on Iran breaks a month-long lull, and Iran fires back
item.dc:creator: Alex Horton, Mohamad El Chamaa, Suzan Haidamous
item.description: The U.S. attack hit rocket launchers in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran fired back early Monday, marking the first known clash in weeks.

item.title: Google unveils ‘Lake America’ for U.S. users
item.dc:creator: Aoife Walsh
item.description: People in Canada will continue to see Lake Ontario on the company's maps, Google said, while those outside of the two countries will see both names.
